phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: But seriously, Thomas, you should listen to Dad at least some of the time. He's only trying to do what is best for us.

phrases.speaker: Kate
phrases.text: It's a little late to start pretending to be modest now, Sarah.

phrases.speaker: King Orwell Rose
phrases.text: Anyone can be a king in the easy times. It's the bad times that a king needs to be ready for. And your brother isn't ready.
